focus_areas: Verification of carapace texture and mottling pattern fidelity.
Boundary separation between overlapping crab legs and bodies.
Structural integrity of visible claws and leg joints.
Realism of the plastic container texture and lighting interaction.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' of legs in the lower-left quadrant. While occlusion is natural, AI often fails to maintain distinct limb boundaries in dense piles. Also, verify if the 'gloss' on the shells is consistent with a wet, hard surface or if it looks like a uniform shader application.
image_description: A high-angle shot of a white rectangular plastic tub containing approximately six to seven live Dungeness crabs. The crabs are piled on top of each other, filling the bottom of the container. Their carapaces are visible, showing the characteristic brownish-purple color with lighter mottling. Several legs and claws are visible protruding from the pile, though many are occluded by other crabs or the angle.
